# Health HIVE

Health HIVE is an AI-powered healthcare ecosystem connecting patients, caregivers, practitioners, and first responders through secure digital tools.

## Public pages

- /: Main marketing landing page — overview of the Health HIVE platform and its services
- /book: Book a consultation or appointment with a Health HIVE practitioner
- /portal: Patient and practitioner portal landing page
- /portal/login: Sign in to the Health HIVE portal
- /portal/signup: Create a new Health HIVE portal account
- /portal/pricing: Membership tiers and pricing plans (Blue, Gold, Red)
- /portal/privacy: Privacy policy and data handling information
- /portal/emergency: Emergency care guidance and rapid-access resources
- /portal/caretaker: Caretaker and family member access information
- /portal/supportive: Supportive and palliative care services
- /portal/responder: First responder integration and resources
